rationale: Identity verification was correctly performed using full name and zip, and the agent accessed the correct user's orders. However, the agent made order-changing writes without first stating the exact changes and obtaining explicit user confirmation, which violates policy. Additionally, the jigsaw exchange did not match the user's request: the user asked for a puzzle with 500 fewer pieces than 1500 (i.e., 1000 pieces) while keeping the same difficulty level; the agent instead selected a 500-piece intermediate puzzle. The agent also failed to disclose the price difference for the new jigsaw variant before proceeding. While the hiking boots exchange to the same specifications was correct in intent, it too was executed without prior confirmation. These issues mean the request was not completed in line with policy.
